_doc: V31 English copy edit of the two staff consoles (agency, university). English only; Korean unchanged (ko omitted, applier keeps it). Changes only calques, vague actions, ambiguity, over-long labels, glossary/console inconsistency, AI-tics and UK spellings. State meanings follow docs/STATE_MAP.md. Audit: docs/qa/v31/l10n/EN_CONSOLES_AUDIT.md.

university:agencies.qualityTitle.en: Offer rate alone is not a measure of quality

university:agencies.qualityBody.en: An agency that only sends a few obviously strong students will show a high offer rate; one that sends many borderline students a lower one. Read offer rate together with volume, readiness at submission and how many offered students actually enroll. Rates based on fewer than 5 decisions are withheld.
